reuse.why: Edits the two existing worst-case helpers in place and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule stays in the two existing shared functions that getScheduledAmount dispatches to.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts where the worst-case helpers already live.

scope.why: Only the two helpers, their comments, tests and the release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Math.min and value minus threshold express 'least money in' directly with an accurate comment; trivially ownable.
